statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail), and r is the largest integer k >= 1 for which there exist cut indices 0 = c_0 < c_1 < ... < c_k = n such that, after sorting each contiguous segment arr[c_{j-1}], arr[c_{j-1}+1], ..., arr[c_j - 1] (for j = 1, ..., k) in nondecreasing order and concatenating the sorted segments in this order, the resulting sequence of length n is exactly 0, 1, ..., n-1.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). 1 <= n <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= arr[i] < n; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < n, arr[i] != arr[j].

statement: The function returns a result r; in particular, for every input satisfying the preconditions it does not overflow, access out of bounds, or panic.
preconditions: Let n = len(arr). 1 <= n <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= arr[i] < n; for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < n, arr[i] != arr[j].
